title: How to help
lead: You can transfer from Argentina, Chile or the United States.
paragraphs: Gifts arrive by bank transfer. This page does not take money: it does not ask for card details, it does not process payments and it does not charge a fee.
Choose your country, copy the details and make the transfer from your bank or wallet, as you would with any other.
afterTransfer: You don't need to do anything else. Each gift is reconciled against the bank statement before it is added to the published total, so the number on this page may take a few days to move.
If you would rather your gift stay anonymous, it already is: we do not publish names or individual amounts.
